en: [calm] Hello, KEY24 auto locksmith service. How can I help? My car keys are lost. Do you have a working spare? No, none. All right. What make, model and year is the vehicle? A Volkswagen Golf, twenty twenty. Thank you. Our example price for all keys lost is three hundred and fifty euros, subject to technical confirmation. Where is the car? At home. We can discuss an example appointment tomorrow between ten and eleven. That works. This is a demonstration, so no actual technician is dispatched.
